pages.text: IV supports Wyvern equipment and further advanced manufacturing. Later Draconic projects lead through LuV, ZPM and UV, bringing increasingly demanding materials, equipment and processing.$(br2)At this point, a new tier should be a working section of your factory. Build the ability to repeat important recipes, replenish its inputs and handle its outputs.

The next EBF coil upgrade after Nichrome is RTM Alloy. Prepare Ruthenium, Tungsten and Molybdenum, then follow JEI for alloy processing.$(br2)Assembling the coils needs Double RTM Alloy Wires, Vanadium Steel Foils and molten Nichrome. The full furnace uses 16 matching coils with a base temperature of 4500 K. An item milestone does not verify the assembled furnace.
